name: Deidesheimer Advent
description: Advent market with about 80 stalls in the wine town's old centre
note: open studios, Ferris wheel from the 2nd Advent
details:
The Deidesheimer Advent fills the old centre of the Palatinate wine town with about 80 stalls of crafts, gifts and regional food. Programme: brass music, sing-alongs, concerts in the churches, theatre in the Boulevard Theater, open studios (goldsmith, ceramics, painting, stonemasonry, glass) and a nativity exhibition; for children the Wichtelstube, the town's sheep in the park and the nostalgic Ferris wheel "Alte Liebe" (2nd to 4th Advent weekend).

Four Advent weekends, 27 November to 20 December 2026: Friday 17-21, Saturday 14-21, Sunday 11-21. The detailed programme and site plan are due in November.
